protocol.primary_comparison: gaussian_patch and tilted_smooth: spatial_validated versus full; three diameter groups separately
protocol.inference: perpendicular MSD; displacement-pair-weighted pooled D; Stokes-Einstein; no truth-based selection
protocol.pn_definition: sum(single(raw),1,2) per frame, convert to double, divide by temporal median; raw/gain then unchanged median pipeline
protocol.illumination_metric: per-pixel temporal population std of (true exposure-averaged gain / estimated gain), after its own temporal-mean normalization; spatial RMS then equal-video RMS; left/right separately
protocol.pairing: same trajectory/background and same shot/read standard-normal draws across conditions; identical raw video across methods; shot-noise scale depends on each condition
protocol.cache_rule: reuse downstream result only when effective single(gain) vectors are exactly equal within the same raw condition
protocol.evidence_rule: active videos >=10 and selected localizations >=5000; CI requires both methods >=4 active videos and >=95% valid replicates; retain empty videos
protocol.comparison_rule: paired B=2000 video bootstrap, common indices per group including empty videos; candidate versus median/pn/full; exploratory pointwise intervals, no multiplicity adjustment; predeclared +1 pp absolute-bias loss margin
protocol.acceptance: computational completeness and integrity are separate from sizing performance; report all cases, including rejection, no improvement, >5% bias and insufficient evidence
protocol.truth_scope: generator truth is used only after inference for illumination, localization, velocity and nominal-size evaluation
protocol.scope: synthetic scalar Debye/Mie camera model; no claim of experimental validation or patent inventiveness
protocol.candidate_definition: 4x4 spatial regions, disjoint separated train/validation pixel blocks, training-only spectral proposal/refinement, protected magnetic bands, quadratic spatial cos/sin coefficient fields, validation-only accept/reject, exact original full fallback
protocol.validation_metric: sqrt(mean_regions(sum_frequencies(cos_error^2+sin_error^2))), coefficient amplitude RMS, not temporal RMS; validation pixels never adjust frequencies or fitted coefficient fields
protocol.local_generator: Gaussian patch, sinusoidally varying smooth mask and unknown oblique discontinuity; none generated from the fitted quadratic polynomial. Exact masks are only in renderer and evaluation metadata.
protocol.inclusion_rule: Require actual camera-video evidence of lower illumination error and preserved sizing; do not treat synthetic quadratic-field tests as end-to-end performance. Failed/boundary cases retained. No automatic patent novelty or inventiveness conclusion.

notes: 独立视频为重抽样单位；空视频保留；所有条件与方法共享配对索引。
点估计与重抽样先合并位移矩再估计D并换算d，不平均单视频粒径。
D和d区间须至少4个有效视频、95%有效重抽样；adequate_evidence另须10个有效视频和5000个定位。
非劣仅为预设+1百分点评价界限下的探索性结果；证据不足不能解释为等效。
主要比较为gaussian_patch和tilted_smooth的spatial_validated对full，三个粒径分别报告；其余探索/边界；所有区间均为点态，未校正多重比较。
照明误差为等长视频RMS平方平均再开方；静态基线为零时不计算相对降低率。
真值匹配与定位误差只作事后诊断；数据完整不等于效果合格或专利成立。
